plan.title: Lemhi Pass and the Shoshone — August 1805
plan.rationale: The filmmaker's brief specifically requests information pertaining to 'Lemhi Pass and the first meeting with the Shoshone, August 1805,' which directly aligns with the 'lemhi-shoshone-august-1805' corpus scope. This scope covers the precise period and subject matter required for the research.

requirements.title: Lemhi Pass Landscape
requirements.production_need: To accurately visualize and recreate the geographical features and challenges of the Lemhi Pass region for set design and cinematography.
requirements.success_criteria: Passages describing the physical characteristics of the land, elevation changes, water bodies, and vegetation encountered around Lemhi Pass.

requirements.title: August Weather Conditions
requirements.production_need: To inform lighting, costume choices, and overall atmospheric mood for scenes set in August 1805.
requirements.success_criteria: Journal entries detailing daily weather observations, including temperature, precipitation, and sky conditions during August 1805.

requirements.title: Expedition Diet and Provisions
requirements.production_need: To authentically depict the daily sustenance, hunting practices, and potential food scarcity faced by the expedition members.
requirements.success_criteria: Descriptions of meals consumed, animals hunted, plants gathered, or any mention of food shortages or abundance.

requirements.title: Shoshone Horses
requirements.production_need: To understand the appearance, condition, and number of horses acquired from the Shoshone for visual accuracy in scenes involving these animals.
requirements.success_criteria: Passages describing the horses obtained, their characteristics, and their immediate use by the expedition.

requirements.title: Horse Trade with Shoshone
requirements.production_need: To accurately portray the interactions, negotiations, and process of trading for horses with the Shoshone people.
requirements.success_criteria: Descriptions of the meetings, discussions, and transactions involved in acquiring horses from the Shoshone.

requirements.title: Expedition Health Status
requirements.production_need: To inform the physical portrayal of the expedition members, reflecting their ailments, injuries, or general well-being during this strenuous period.
requirements.success_criteria: Journal entries detailing any illnesses, injuries, or general physical condition of the expedition members.
